Hi Sandra —

Great to have Elara Health moving into activation. I'm Monica on the CS side; I’ll own the implementation handoff and coordinate with our infra engineer for API key seeding and role setup. High-level plan attached. TL;DR: we need an admin list, target region, and your SAML/SCIM preference so we can provision org-level roles and seed a short-lived staging API key for initial tests.

What I need from you before the kickoff call (proposed below):
- Confirm desired region (us-west-2 / us-east-1) and whether you prefer managed SAML via Okta or just manual admin invites for the pilot.
- Provide list of 1–2 initial org admins (name + email).
- Confirm whether you want Redwood to create a service account for your integration or if you will manage keys from your vault (we support both).

Proposed kickoff: Thu 2026-10-22 11:00 PT — 30 minutes to walk initial steps and hand over API key. If that works I’ll send calendar invites and include Ben (implementation) and Karthik (CS manager).

Attachment: initial-onboard-checklist.xlsx (checklist includes steps for project creation, role mapping, API key lifecycle, and test plan).

Thanks — speak soon,
Monica
